edition_policy: No edition identifier may be parsed from ISBN-like URL suffixes or display titles. Include an explicit edition identifier only from a separately accepted, exact source-local edition record; all six bounded samples therefore use null.
reference_policy: Only accepted source-local catalog row_id and its exact HTTPS source_locator may be used as references. Do not invent canonical work IDs or turn unverified discovery metadata into verified canon.
visual_policy: Existing deterministic abstract renderer keys motifs to medium + NUL + source-local row ID, escaping title text. SVG is explicitly labeled NOT OFFICIAL ART; no film/episode footage, cover, insignia, logo, artist style imitation, remote image, audio or third-party media.
non_endorsement_policy: Index cards are repository-created navigation graphics with factual titles only; not officially endorsed franchise assets or licensed studio images. Existing source-available repository license governs original repo-owned code/art, not any third-party image.
